name: arch-diagram
description: Turn a GitHub repo, article, PDF or local project into an animated Atelier architecture diagram: HTML, PNG, looping MP4/GIF or Mermaid, with a live trace log.

interface.shortDescription: Animated architecture diagrams from any repo or article
interface.longDescription: Reads a GitHub repo, article, PDF or local project and draws a dark Atelier architecture diagram with typed animated wires and a live trace log. Exports HTML, PNG, looping MP4/GIF and Mermaid. The diagram is written in the language of your prompt.
defaultPrompt: Draw the architecture of this repository.
Turn this article into a flowchart and export a 20-second video.
Export the last diagram as a PNG and as Mermaid.
